name: alumniconnectsih
description: 🎓 Alumni Connect A web application to connect students and alumni through a verified registration system with email OTP authentication and secure login. ⚙️ Technologies Used - Node.js & Express.js - MongoDB & Mongoose - Nodemailer (for OTP emails) - dotenv (for environment variables) - bcryptjs (for secure password hashing) - jsonwebtoken (for login security) - Postman (for API testing) 🚀 How to Run This Project (Backend Setup) **Step 1:** Clone the Repository     git clone https://github.com/Kamali-R/alumni-connect.git
